raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner accepted a misleading search snippet and prematurely concluded that Philip of Sicily’s father was Charles II. This ignored disambiguation and source verification; in fact, Philip (1255/56–1277) was the son of Charles I of Sicily (Charles of Anjou), and the dates make Charles II (born 1254) an impossible father.
